purpose: Raw Amazon Musical Instruments review corpus underlying the CARE-GNN Amazon fraud graph (Amazon.mat), needed to recover per-node TEXT for FLAG.
certificate_caveat: NONE. No download used --insecure / -k / verify=False. The canonical host jmcauley.ucsd.edu HAS an expired certificate (notAfter=May 21 23:59:59 2026 GMT, ~4 months expired as of 2026-09-17) and was NOT used. All files were obtained over fully-validated TLS from two authoritative alternatives reached via McAuley's own live dataset pages on cseweb.ucsd.edu.
authority_chain: https://cseweb.ucsd.edu/~jmcauley/datasets/amazon/links.html  (HTTP 200, valid TLS) = Julian McAuley's own 2014 'Amazon product data' page; its download links point at snap.stanford.edu.
https://cseweb.ucsd.edu/~jmcauley/datasets/amazon_v2/index.html  (HTTP 200, valid TLS) = McAuley's own 2018 'Amazon Review Data' page; its download links point at mcauleylab.ucsd.edu.

files.role: PRIMARY - established as the corpus the fraud benchmark was built from (see verification block)
files.release: 2014 'Amazon product data' (McAuley), FULL category dump, NOT k-core filtered
files.description: Full (non-5-core) Amazon Musical Instruments reviews, 2014 McAuley release, hosted by SNAP (Stanford) as linked from McAuley's official page. Contains the helpful:[helpful_votes,total_votes] pair required by the fraud-benchmark labelling rule.

files.role: CONTROL - 2014 5-core; RULED OUT as the benchmark source
files.description: 2014 5-core Musical Instruments. Matches McAuley's stated '10,261 reviews'. Only 1,429 reviewers - cannot be the source of an 11,944-node user graph.

files.role: CONTROL - 2018 5-core; RULED OUT as the benchmark source
files.description: 2018 5-core Musical Instruments. Matches McAuley's stated '231,392 reviews'. Uses 'vote' (helpful count only, no denominator) instead of 'helpful':[h,t] - the fraud labelling rule is NOT computable from this release.

benchmark_reconstruction_verified.target_graph: CARE-GNN Amazon.mat - 11944 user nodes, 25 features, 821 fraud, 3305 unlabeled [0,3305), 8639 labeled
benchmark_reconstruction_verified.rule_applied: From reviews_Musical_Instruments.json.gz: keep reviewers with sum(helpful[1]) >= 20 total votes; benign if sum(helpful[0])/sum(helpful[1]) > 0.80; fraudulent if < 0.20
benchmark_reconstruction_verified.residual_unexplained: cohort is 497 short of 11944; the entire shortfall sits in the UNLABELED/ambiguous band (2808 vs 3305). Labeled counts match exactly. Cause UNKNOWN.
benchmark_reconstruction_verified.adjacent_thresholds_rejected: sum_tv>=19 gives fraud=894/benign=8283; sum_tv>=21 gives fraud=765/benign=7373. Only >=20 matches.
